prints.title: Corgi figure, 10 cm
prints.summary: A sculpted corgi from Nomad Sculpt, scaled to 10 cm nose to tail and printed standing on its feet.

prints.title: Ram skull headpiece and skeleton pieces
prints.summary: A ram skull with sweeping horns that sits on the head, a 21-piece spine, 8 arm pieces and 6 ribs, in white PLA over four plates.

prints.title: Wall mount for iPad 11-inch (portrait)
prints.summary: A screw-on cradle the iPad stands in, with the middle left open for a USB-C charging cable, plus two turn clips that hold the top edge.

prints.title: iPhone 11 case with honeycomb and name inlay
prints.summary: Snap-on case with a fading honeycomb and a stencil-cut name. A colored inner plate fills the cutouts and frames the camera.
prints.material: PLA prototype (TPU for the final case)

prints.title: Sun mask with glued-on rays
prints.summary: A sun face mask, 19 cm across, with 16 rays (8 wavy, 8 straight) printed separately and glued around it: 37 cm in all.
